jobs.occupation: Administrative Lab Technician (Biologielaborant/in)
jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.Our Junior Research Group "Epithelium Microbiome Interactions" (headed by Dr. Jens Puschhof) is seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Administrative Lab Technician.In the EMIL group, we study how bacteria contribute to cancer development, metastasis, and treatment response. Our team includes cancer researchers, tissue engineers, microbiologists, and bioinformaticians working together to help patients by deciphering the functional impacts of bacteria in human tumors.Using tissue samples from patients, we isolate bacterial strains and create organoids. These models can be combined with additional features of the human gut on USB stick-sized devices, “organ chips”, for detailed studies. We transplant organoid-bacteria mixtures into mouse models to study their migration and interaction in a whole-body context.In our unique biobank at DKFZ, we characterize both tumor organoids and tumor-resident bacterial strains through whole genome sequencing, fluorescence microscopy, and other cutting-edge methods. Based on the diverse data obtained, we develop hypotheses about how specific bacterial species might influence tumors. With our broad portfolio of patient-derived models, our main focus lies on testing these relationships. Through close collaborations with clinical partners, we work towards the rapid translation of our findings into new microbiome-based strategies for the detection, prevention, and treatment of cancer.Your Tasks- Organization and coordination of day-to-day laboratory operations, including inventory management, procurement, equipment maintenance, shipping, and logistics- Coordination of occupational safety, biosafety, and laboratory safety procedures, including support with regulatory documentation and internal inspections- Organization and quality control of shared consumables, reagents, and laboratory spaces- Experimental and administrative management of the organoid biobank and bacterial strain collection- Performance and coordination of key laboratory assays, particularly genotyping and mycoplasma testing- Onboarding, practical instruction, and supervision of students and new group members- Communication and coordination with suppliers, service providers, internal DKFZ units, and external collaboration partnersYour Profile- Completed vocational training as a laboratory technician or an equivalent qualification- Very good practical knowledge of biological and/or molecular biology laboratory work and laboratory organization- Ideally, experience with inventory management, procurement, equipment coordination, and laboratory documentation- Knowledge of occupational safety, biosafety, and relevant documentation requirements is an advantage- Independent, structured, and reliable working style with strong organizational skills- Very good communication and coordination skills when working with scientists, students, internal service units, and external partners- Motivation to work in a diverse role combining hands-on laboratory work with administrative and organizational responsibilities- Very good written and spoken English and GermanWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-beingAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Dr. Jens PuschhofPhone: +49 6221 42 4953​Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.Application Deadline: November 4, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

jobs.occupation: Compliance Coordinator (all genders) (Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description: What we are looking forBecome part of Fairmas as a Junior Compliance Coordinator (all genders) and help us build a solid foundation for our information security management system. The role sits at the intersection of compliance, information security, process management, and documentation — coordinating requirements, structuring evidence, and making our processes audit-ready. You will work closely with management, IT, HR, legal, and data protection, acting as a coordinating and documenting function rather than the sole owner of all information security.Location:Based in Berlin | Full-time or part-time | Monday to Friday | Work-life balance guaranteed.Do you have a sharp eye for detail, a talent for turning complex requirements into clear documentation, and a genuine interest in information security and compliance? Do you enjoy staying on top of open tasks, deadlines, and responsibilities across multiple teams?Then Fairmas is the right place for you.What we have in store for you• Balance: No weekend work, no shifts, no overtime.• Appreciation: Fair pay and a safe working environment.• Flexibility: Work remotely and from our modern Berlin office – 3 days/week in the office required.• Understanding: Many of us come from the hotel industry ourselves.• Purpose: Help hotels around the world stay economically successful.• Sustainability: Our offices are eco-friendly and perfectly connected.• Mobility: We subsidize your Deutschlandticket.• Growth: Through team events and personal development – we support what makes you unique.Your background• Foundation: Degree/ background in business law, IT law, business informatics, compliance, quality management, or a related field — or a relevant lateral entry from data protection, audit support, or process management.• Compliance mindset: Ability to read, understand, and translate requirements from standards, contracts, and regulations into tasks and documentation.• Security interest: First exposure to ISO 27001, information security, data protection, or audit processes is a plus• IT fluency: You don’t need to be a sysadmin, but you understand basic IT and security concepts such as user and access management, cloud systems, backup, change management, and incident management, and communicate confidently with technical colleagues.• Writing strength: Excellent written German and English; able to document complex topics clearly, precisely, and in an audit-ready way.• Structure: Systematic, thorough, and reliable — you keep track of open points, deadlines, and responsibilities without being prompted.• Collaboration: Professional and clear communicator with management, IT, legal, HR, and data protection stakeholders.• Discretion: High sense of responsibility when handling sensitive information.• Tools: Experience with tools such as Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Notion, Excel, or GRC tools is a benefit.• Regulatory knowledge: Basic knowledge of GDPR, IT law, data protection law, or contract review is a plus• Industry background: Experience in a software, SaaS, or IT-oriented company is an advantage.• Employment Eligibility: Must be legally authorized to in Germany.How you make an impact• ISMS Development: Support the setup, structuring, and maintenance of our ISO 27001-compliant information security management system — as a coordinating and documenting function in close exchange with management, IT, HR, legal, and data protection.• Requirements Analysis: Break down ISO 27001 controls, identify gaps, assign responsibilities, and track required evidence.• Documentation: Create, revise, and maintain policies, process descriptions, work instructions, checklists, and audit evidence documents.• Audit Preparation: Compile and organize audit materials; ensure all required evidence is in place and traceable.• Task Tracking: Maintain an up-to-date action and task plan including status, owners, deadlines, and open items.• Risk Management: Assist with gap analyses, risk assessments, and documenting risk treatment measures.• Cross-Team Coordination: Gather information and coordinate with IT, HR, legal, data protection, management, and relevant departments.• Process Documentation: Document security processes such as access management, change management, incident management, backup, vendor management, asset management, and awareness programs.• Follow-Through: Track and close open points from internal reviews, external consultations, audits, and management decisions.• Stakeholder Communication: Prepare clear decision bases and summaries for management and business units.Get in Touch! Ready to Join Us? Send us your CV – feel free to include your earliest possible start date. If you have any questions, reach out to us at hr@fairmas.com – we’re happy to help.You don’t meet every single requirement or have gaps in your resume? No problem!Apply anyway – what matters most to us are your motivation, values, and personality.About usFairmas GmbH and its affiliates is a hotel software company specializing in web-based solutions for financial planning, controlling, and management reporting. Since our founding in 2003 in Berlin, our dedicated team, including hoteliers, IT experts, and professionals from a variety of backgrounds, has been supporting more than 18,000 users across 5,500 hotels worldwide.We take pride in delivering first-class service built on years of experience. At Fairmas, we foster a company culture defined by transparency, mutual respect, and strong team spirit. For us, work-life balance isn’t just a buzzword — it’s essential to maintaining long-term motivation and creativity. We firmly believe that our employees are the driving force behind Fairmas, and their ideas and contributions actively shape our company’s future.
